SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
CRIME REGISTRY
No 7118
Date 16. 1. 41.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SP. BR. REGISTRY
No. 14. 616
Date. 31 / 1 / 41

January 16 41.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your letter of January 6, 1941, on the subject of
Mrs. E. Tomaeff (reference S.B. 247/1002/40,ECL/KEP).

Mrs. E. A. Tomaeff, referred to as Princess
Tomaeff, is at present living at premises Lane 925,
House 2, Avenue Joffre, in the French Concession of
Shanghai.

Though it has not been possible to obtain
corroboration, the information as given in the first
three paragraphs of your letter is ascertained to be
substantially correct.

Regarding the status of White Russians
living in Shanghai, during September 1940, the late
Mayor Fu Siao En, Mayor of the City Government of
Greater Shanghai, issued an order to Mr. Ivanoff,
Chairman of the Russian Emigrants Committee in Shanghai,
that all Russian emigres would be subject to the
jurisdiction of the Nantao Court of the Shanghai City
Government.

This order never came into effect and Russian
emigres living in the International and French Concession
of Shanghai continued to be subject to the jurisdiction
of the First and Second area, Shanghai Special District
Courts respectively.

DATE 30 1/41

1941年1月16日。

先生：

谨此确认收到您1941年1月6日关于E. 托马耶夫夫人（Tomaeff）事宜的来信（参考号 S.B. 247/1002/40, ECL/KEP）。

E. A. 托马耶夫夫人，被称为托马耶夫公主，目前居住在上海法租界霞飞路925弄2号。

虽然未能获得佐证，但经核实，您来信前三段所述信息基本属实。

关于居住在上海的白俄人士的地位问题，1940年9月，已故大上海市政府市长傅筱庵向上海俄国侨民委员会主席伊万诺夫先生（Ivanoff）发布命令，规定所有俄国侨民均须受上海市政府南市法院的管辖。

该命令从未生效，居住在上海国际租界和法租界的俄国侨民继续分别受上海第一特区地方法院和第二特区地方法院的管辖。

日期 1941年1月30日

pages.en:
-2-

On November 8, 1940, the Second Area,
Shanghai Special District Court, situated in
the French Concession, was taken over by
representatives of the Nanking Government
thus all Russians resident within the French
Concession are subject to the jurisdiction
of this Court.

Russians resident in the International
Settlement of Shanghai remain subject to the
jurisdiction of the First Area, Shanghai Special
District Court (Chungking).

I am of the opinion that there is no
valid reason to fear for the safety of
Mrs. E. Tomaeff.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Deputy Commissioner of Police

Commissioner of Police,
HONG KONG.
pages.zh:
-2-

1940年11月8日，位于法租界的上海第二特区地方法院被南京政府代表接管，因此，所有居住在法租界内的俄国人现均受该法院管辖。

居住在上海国际租界的俄国人仍受上海第一特区地方法院（重庆方面）的管辖。

本人认为，没有正当理由担心E. 托马耶夫夫人的安全。

谨此呈复，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

副警务处长

警务处处长，
香港。

ECL/EEP
NUMBER AND DATE SHOULD
BE QUOTED IN REFERENCE
TO THIS LETTER

G. R.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE CRIME REGISTRY No E. 3212 Date 10 / 1 / 41）

（印：SP. CR. REGISTRY No 61 POLICE HEADQUARTERS, HONG KONG. Date 31 / 1 / 41）

6th January, 1941.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that the Honourable
the Colonial Secretary has requested me to solicit information
regarding the conditions prevailing in Shanghai with special
reference to Mrs. E. Tomaeff now in Shanghai and a resident of
Hong Kong.

Mr. Tomaeff has applied to the Colonial Secretary
for permission for his wife to return to Hong Kong on the
following grounds which I have extracted from his letter:-

1. While in charge of the Chinese Stamps Printing Bureau
at Peiping, I was arrested by the Japanese military
authorities there demanding from me the delivery to
them of the stamps printing plates. I was kept under
arrest for 66 days, and my wife was forbidden to leave
the Bureau.

2. After being released, HBM Legation at Peiping, with
complete knowledge of my case, has sympathetically arran-
ged our coming here.

3. My wife has proceeded to Shanghai at her own accord on
13th July, 1940.

4. The status quo of White Russians, living in Shanghai,
has lately been changed. They have been placed under
jurisdiction of the Japanese sponsored Court at Nantao.
Consequently it is thought that it would be rather
dangerous for my wife to further remain at Shanghai as
she might again be intimidated owing to prevailing
conditions there. Thus, the present application for
your favourable consideration.

（批：Passed to whether）
（印：SPECIAL）

I am therefore requesting that enquiries be made
as to whether the fears stated in Mr. Tomaeff's letter under
reference for the safety of his wife in Shanghai are justified.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

（签名）

p. Commissioner of Police.

The Deputy Commissioner
of Police (Crime),
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

G. R.

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处罪案登记处 编号 E. 3212 日期 1941年1月10日）

（印章：特别罪案登记处 编号 61 香港警察总部。日期 1941年1月31日）

1941年1月6日。

先生：

谨此告知，尊敬的辅政司要求我搜集有关上海现行状况的情报，特别是关于现居上海且为香港居民的E. 托马耶夫夫人的情况。

托马耶夫先生已向辅政司申请许可其妻子返回香港，理由如下，摘录自其来信：

1. 我在北平负责中国印花税票印刷局期间，被当地日本军事当局逮捕，他们要求我交出印版。我被拘押了66天，我的妻子也被禁止离开该局。

2. 获释后，英国驻北平公使馆在完全了解我案情的情况下，同情地安排了我们来此。

3. 我的妻子于1940年7月13日自行前往上海。

4. 居住在上海的白俄人士的地位最近发生了变化。他们已被置于南市由日本支持的法院管辖之下。因此，人们认为我的妻子继续留在上海会比较危险，因为鉴于当地的现状，她可能会再次受到恐吓。故此，提出本申请，恳请予以有利考虑。

（批注：转交以确认是否）
（印章：特别）

因此，我请求调查托马耶夫先生在上述参考信件中所述的对其妻子在上海安全的担忧是否有根据。

谨此呈复，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

（签名）

代 警务处处长。

副警务处长（罪案），
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。
